proposal.root_problem: The gateway's idempotency key enforcement was turned off on 2026-09-09, causing gateway timeout retries to lack an idempotency key and be processed as duplicate captures by the PSP, resulting in double charges.
proposal.requested_solution: Build an AI assistant that drafts apology replies to customers who complain about being charged twice
causal_chain: SH-PAY disables idempotency key enforcement on the payment gateway (config change CHG-77 on 2026-09-09).
Gateway experiences timeout retries at a baseline rate of ~120 per day.
Without idempotency key, timeout retries are sent to the PSP lacking the deduplication key.
PSP processes the retry as a new capture, creating a second capture for the same order.
Orders receive two captures, observable as orders_with_2_captures in the charge ledger.
Customers observe double charges and file support tickets, causing the spike in double-charge complaints.

assumptions.statement: Gateway timeout retries rate remains stable after re-enabling idempotency key enforcement.
PSP will continue to drop retried captures when an idempotency key is present (deduplication works).
